name: zgame_options_find_option
description: zGame::Options_FindOption scans the global option-entry list for an exact option name match and returns the matched entry or null.
known_limits: Binary Ninja cannot lift the inlined strcmp mismatch sbb flag sequence at 0x4b33bd, so the reconstruction marker remains limited; assembly evidence validates exact string-compare behavior.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?Options_FindOption@zGame@@YIPAUzOptionEntryPartial@@PBD@Z at 0x4b3380 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after masking 4 COFF relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 98 bytes and the VC object symbol is 112 bytes with 14 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b3380 validates loading g_zGame_Options_OptionListHead, preserving the requested name, scanning option entries by next pointer, comparing against entry->name with an inlined strcmp-equivalent loop, returning the matched entry on zero compare, and returning null for an empty list or exhausted search.
